title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the BFRO in July.
The BFRO has documented 126 credible Bigfoot sightings in New England since 1994, including multiple in Connecticut.
Boston University Professor Eva Garrett remains skeptical, citing the lack of scientific evidence for Bigfoot's existence.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Meredith Goldstein reflects on her friendship with the late advice columnist Margo Howard, who passed away at 86.
Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, was known for her empathetic yet no-nonsense advice in her columns.
Margo taught Goldstein to find happiness after loss, encouraging her to grieve but to also move forward.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox extend winning streak to nine games with a 13-1 victory over the Athletics at Fenway Park.
Payton Tolle strikes out a career-high 14 batters, allowing only two hits and no walks over six innings.
Boston's offense accumulates 15 hits, highlighted by two-run homers and multiple high-scoring innings.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in competitive training camp battles to sharpen their skills for the Patriots.
Christian Gonzalez uses trash talk to prepare A.J. Brown for the challenges from other top NFL corners.
Gonzalez seeks a new contract while actively participating in training, anticipating a challenging 2026 season.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester Saturday after wrist inflammation.
Rutschman was acquired by Boston from Baltimore for three prospects and catcher Carlos Narvaez.
The three-time All-Star aims to return as Boston's main catcher, boosting their playoff chances.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' is now streaming on Paramount+, offering a continuation of the iconic Nickelodeon series.
'You, Me & Tuscany', a romantic comedy starring Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page, is available on Peacock.
Season 4 of 'Ted Lasso', featuring the coach of a women's football team, is streaming on Apple TV.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet, sidelined since April with injuries, is considering a return to the Red Sox in a bullpen role.
Crochet has started throwing short tosses, recently overcoming shoulder inflammation and a lat strain.
Interim manager Chad Tracy suggests Crochet is more likely to contribute as a reliever rather than a starter in 2026.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python, nicknamed 'Tippy', was found near Ellington Street in a community garden in Dorchester, Boston.
Tippy was left in a cage by an unknown individual, and transported to a facility by Boston Animal Care and Control.
The snake is in good condition, and officials request owners to contact Boston Animal Care and Control with information.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Team Blue led by Tommy DeVito defeated Drake Maye's Team White 22-15 in Patriots' training camp scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas stood out for Team Blue with six catches and two touchdowns, including a 50-yard play.
Injury updates: LT Will Campbell and CB Carlton Davis are expected to return after missing recent practices.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
The town boasts nearly 11 miles of shoreline on Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay, with more than 20 beaches.
Harwich offers culture, history, conservation areas, and diverse activities for all ages, according to Town Clerk Emily Mitchell.
